items.original: TDE-3 prior for OF wake with texture inhibition
items.actual: 1-D left/right age comparison, capped gap confidence plus polarity/hint boost, both-fresh conflict penalty; event-gated wake.
items.gap: Age advances only on valid_i, no timestamp, velocity coding or gain-reset inhibitory state. Old left=200/right=255 still yields conf=7 on a new event. Not instantiated in front/top.
items.tb: tb_c1star/tb_c1s_tde3_prior.sv:107-195: two directed motions, idle, OR; no event trace or texture/velocity validation.

items.gap: Only TB instantiates it. TB drives valid_i instead of tde_valid; Case4 manually carries held_tde into op_stw input, so no back-to-back alignment proof. OR can only add wake bits versus its inputs.

items.original: Tw split, lookup alignment and temporal motion aggregation
items.actual: Adjacent 1-D previous-feature lookup, equality counter, nonzero current pass-through/zero fill, hit-popcount exit flag.
items.gap: slice_idx only stored to unused last_slice: no slicing or window reset. Zero features retain counts and can retain hits. No feature extractor, flow-based 2-D bilinear sampling, attention or real exit consumer.
items.tb: tb_c2star/tb_c2s_tma_agg.sv:120-152 prints PASS for directional lookup without asserting expected lookup/hypothesis.

items.original: BAT bidirectional correlation and SATMA adaptive fusion
items.actual: External fwd/bwd equality; counters, average with external TMA, halve on conflict; only first/last tile are edges.
items.gap: No backward-feature/correlation/warp producer or SATMA offset network/attention. slice_idx unused. FEAT_W-bit (fwd+tma)>>1 loses carry: at W=4,12+12 gives4, not12 (static sizing inference, not simulated). No top/back consumer.
items.tb: tb_c2star/tb_c2s_bisat_agg.sv:141-145,169-173 inject all three feature buses; no large-sum or negative features.

items.original: EMD confidence-guided propagation and exact budget
items.actual: Saturate unsigned external peak to conf, compare one threshold, scale budget by non-propagated count.
items.gap: No peak producer, calibrated confidence or propagated flow. TH_LO has no effect. Width-BUDGET_W product can wrap before division (8-bit budget255, n_need8 gives31 rather than255; static sizing inference). n_need counts unmatched tiles. No admission/debit handshake.
items.tb: tb_c1star/tb_c1s_cfp_confgate.sv:119-126 is expressly stub OGEC and software capture counters, no actual PRRC/capture instance.

items.actual: Correctly widened signed absolute difference, invert to 8-bit quality, average threshold, scrub/hold flags.
items.gap: f2_warp is external; f_hat has no effect. No warp engine, trained quality-channel consumer or iterative refiner in frozen U-Net. Dirty hold lacks recovery/forward-progress protocol. Not SciFlow Gaussian vector affinity.
items.tb: tb_c1star/tb_c1s_sci_cleanexit.sv:108-110 counts allowed beats only; neither capture nor scrub FSM is instantiated.

items.actual: External unsigned ub/lb/score, constant TH_DROP, width/magnitude heuristic; payload mask AND scalar gate.
items.gap: No bound producer or max-relative threshold. ub80/lb0/score2 sets keep0 despite unresolved score, guard_valid1 with ooo_ready0; TB counts that as drop. No refinement queue or replay. Dropping H67 score can change global Shiftmax denominator even when K=0.
items.tb: tb_c2star/tb_c2s_bui_guard_sdsa.sv:188-218 intentionally accepts unresolved weak-score drop, comparing mask counts not equal network output.

integration.instances: rg across rtl_c1star/rtl_c2star: all seven G/H names appear only in own module declarations/comments; absent from front/back/top instance lists.
integration.capture: c1s_exact_capture_wrap.sv:18-27,41-57,87-92 has no product/address/context ports or RAM: OR bitmap plus saturating counter. Partial final capacity does not select accepted hits. valid_i while capture_en falls in BUSY still adds hits.
integration.budget: c1s_prrc_ledger.sv:32-59,69-77 is three explicit counters, spends one per external spend_i, not per accepted hit. allow_exact is combinational and independent of valid. c1s_top.sv:129-160 exposes independent PRRC/capture valid and spend; no atomic debit/admit identity.
integration.payload: c2s_hbg_rp_packetizer.sv:26-42 handles -128 abs correctly but EPS=1 deletes +/-1; frozen binary nonzeros folded to1 would all disappear. back_pipe holds payload to align gp_valid; SMAM is pass-through plus +1 counter, not a MAC. HBG int8 is a new model proposal.
integration.wake_to_exact: c1s_top.sv:117-160 exact admission uses external match_ok through OGEC and independent PRRC only; OP-STW wake, ECP proj_en and MW delta_nz never feed exact_en/capture. front_pipe tile_active is separate output with no top connection. Thus even older Knife1->Knife3 chain is not closed by this top.

regression.receipt: out/REGRESSION_REPORT.md:7-38 records25 scripts rc0. run_all.sh:17-39 enumerates sim_*.sh; sim_bisat_agg.sh uses iverilog/vvp and PASS marker.
regression.proves: Archived directed control cases passed according to receipt; several TB assertions test intended gate reductions by construction.
regression.does_not_prove: No frozen trace end-to-end equality, algorithm accuracy, missing producer cost, ready/backpressure, per-frame identity, model cycles, foundry PPA or same-workload VCS/DC/PT/FM. This review did not rerun regression.

sources.distinction: Flow-indexed 2-D bilinear temporal correlations, motion encoder, learned offsets, deformable attention and ConvGRU; not equality/mean. Backward cues need not imply future events.

Derives intervals from Q and remaining signed Key bit planes; threshold from current row lower-bound maximum and pruning margin, coupled to bitwise execution. No claim that its approximate sparse attention is bit-exact dense softmax.

reconstruction_seeds.name: Motion-XOR whole-row gate certificate
reconstruction_seeds.migration: Borrow PADE partial-evaluation idea, replace invented score bounds by exact remaining-channel bounds for overlap/same-zero/temporal-XOR. Carry row-max and sum-of-exponent intervals through specified Q7/Shiftmax/gate rounding; commit a gate only when every completion yields the same gate code. Refine token/channel blocks that straddle a denominator power-of-two boundary. Temporal prior may select refinement order only.
reconstruction_seeds.distinct_circuit_question: Can a shared row certificate retire consumers while other scores remain partial, preserving denominator effects, with fewer source reads/popcounts than complete scores? This is a normalization/commit mechanism, not constant-threshold pruning.
reconstruction_seeds.fit: A separately specified integer deployment component; not frozen FP ep34 equivalence. K=0 value suppression must retain normalization influence. Existing score width32 may make bounds overhead worse.
reconstruction_seeds.minimum_gate: Exact finite-arithmetic exhaustive small rows; all real row gates; bound-generator/read/refinement/commit costs against full popcount+Shiftmax; count denominator-boundary failures. No claimed benefit before this.

identity_evidence.observation: Token-local feature score then global Shiftmax normalization; temporal K peer. Plain score deletion changes max/sum dependencies.
Existing Q7 component specifies round-even overlap/same-zero/motion sum; differs from frozen floating-point model contract.

qa.arithmetic_counterexamples: Static SystemVerilog expression-width analysis; no simulator or EDA invoked.

post_review_addendum.reason: Parent identified existing repository mechanisms; independently checked stated source sections. Existing class/multiplicity frontend and strict Q-only/QKM denominator certificates substantially pre-empt normalization certificate story. Uncertainty-driven whole gate-code retirement beyond denominator is unimplemented and has no evidenced payoff.

evidence.finding: Historical workload class-scan-only upper bound about1.014 model; not ep34 speedup or PPA. Document explicitly declines main-mechanism status.
